title: Ishyaka ry’Ubumwe ryatumiye amatongo
intro: Tekereza ucumbikiwe munsi y’igisenge kimwe n’ibyahishuwe, ariko ugahitamo ubudahemuka butandukanye. Uyu muntu yabanye hafi y’ukuri n’ubuhanuzi, ariko agahindukira areba ababyanze. Inkuru yabo ihagaze nk’umuburo ukomeye w’uko kwegera gukiranuka byonyine bidashobora gukiza ubugingo bugambanira icyizere.
clues: Nabaye mu rugo rw'umuhanuzi watoranyijwe na Allah.
Nari nzi ukuri umugabo wanjye yabwirizaga, ariko sinakwemeye by'ukuri.
Namuhemukiye ubwo namushyigikiraga mu bantu be banze kandi nkabafasha kumurwanya.
Ndavugwa hamwe n'undi mugore w'umuhanuzi nawe wahemutse, nk'urugero ku batizera.
Inkuru yanjye ivugwa muri Surah At-Tahrim nk'umuburo w'uko isano n'abahanuzi ntacyo bitanga.
Narimbutse hamwe n'abagizi ba nabi ubwo Allah yarimburaga abantu ba Luti, asigarana n'abasigaye.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Shyira uruhinja mu ruzi mu gitebo kugira ngo rubakize
Yasabye ko hubakwa inyana ya zahabu mu gihe umuhanuzi atari ahari
Yashinje umukozi w’Imana w’intungane icyaha cy’ubugizi bwa nabi maze aramufunga
Yayoboye ingabo z'inzovu kugira ngo zisenye Kaaba

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yazize hamwe n'abatizera nubwo yashakanye n'umuhanuzi
Yarokowe hamwe n'abizera maze yinjira muri Paradizo mu mahoro
outcome.answer: Yazize hamwe n'abatizera nubwo yashakanye n'umuhanuzi

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
